messages:
isabel: Quick check-in: Suncrest Security stalled the POC. They say SAML assertion audiences are mismatched and SCIM deprovision semantics unclear. Can we give them a tidy checklist?

tom: On audiences we expect `https://api.redwood.ai/saml/<org_id>` or the entityID they uploaded. Common mismatch when IdP uses entityID with trailing slash.

isabel: Got it. They also want to know whether a SCIM DELETE is required to fully remove a user or if PATCH active:false is acceptable. Procurement also asked if SCIM activity counts towards billing.

sam: SCIM semantics: `PATCH active:false` = disable (keeps record/history), `DELETE` = full deletion and emits `user.deleted` event. Both supported. We include externalId in audit payloads to help reconciliation.

sam: Billing: SCIM provisioning is a control-plane operation and not billed per-token. For Hosted plans it's included; Dedicated/Private customers get SCIM in-tier but Professional services may apply for on-prem connectors.

security: They requested assertion-level audience enforcement and an audience whitelist per workspace. We already support `audience` validation and config per SAML integration. Also, recommend enforcing `NameID` format `urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress` for user mapping.

isabel: Can someone paste the minimal SAML metadata upload curl and the TXT/HTTP verification options? They are leaning toward DNS TXT but want the fallback.

tom: TXT value pattern: `_redwood_verify=suncrest-1845` (replace domain). HTTP proof: place a file at `/.well-known/redwood-verification.txt` with that token as the sole content.

tom: SAML upload curl:
```
curl -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <admin-token>" \
  -F "metadata=@suncrest-metadata.xml" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/saml/metadata
```

isabel: RBAC mapping: can they map one IdP group to multiple Redwood roles? They asked for nested group support.

sam: Yes — multiple mappings allowed. Nested groups are flattened by most IdPs; if nested groups are present in the SAML assertion we parse `http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/claims/Group` entries. Best practice: map explicit group names rather than paths. Example mapping snippet: `{"idp_group":"Engineering","redwood_roles":["app_user","deploy_view"]}`.

infra-bot: Temporary POC workspace `suncrest-poc-1845` created, expires 2025-10-20T00:00:00Z. Invite: https://console.redwood.ai/p/suncrest-poc-1845/invite

sales-bot: Note for commercial: if they plan 10k active identities in pilot with daily full syncs, recommend setting SCIM batching to 500 and using incremental syncs to reduce load. Control-plane cost minimal; add-on for audit export/HSM applies if they require 12mo retention and signed webhooks.

isabel: Perfect. I'll forward these bits + the workspace link. If they still see audience mismatch I'll ask for the raw assertion sample (PII redacted). Thanks all :thumbsup:
